dimensions.label: Right-left (rile)
dimensions.note: The codebook's right-left formula (percentage points) recomputed on whole categories; kept for comparison with CHES only.

dimensions.label: Multiculturalism
dimensions.note: CHES scores high for opposing multiculturalism.

dimensions.label: Traditional morality
dimensions.note: One measure for two CHES dimensions: the categories cannot tell social lifestyle from religious principles.

dimensions.label: Public spending and taxes
dimensions.note: Welfare and education limitation and economic orthodoxy against their expansion.

dimensions.label: Redistribution
dimensions.note: Rougher than the others: there is no category against equality.

dimensions.label: Regional autonomy
dimensions.note: CHES scores high for opposing decentralisation, so a negative correlation is expected.

dimensions.label: Salience of agriculture and farmers
dimensions.note: A proxy for CHES's urban-rural dimension, which scores high for rural interests.

dimensions.label: Salience of underprivileged minorities
dimensions.note: Positive mentions only, so expected to correlate negatively with CHES's ethnic minorities scale, which scores high for opposing their rights.
